### Retry paints plates as locked **Medium Severity** `loading` is only `cosmetics === null`, and `unknown` is only `syncState === 'error'`. `retry()` sets `syncState` to `loading` while leaving the last (neutral) payload in place, so the register and sheet drop the unknown treatment and paint every plate as `LOCKED` with dither and `GET IT` until the resync finishes.
Additional Locations (2) - [`src/app/(app)/bag/page.tsx#L213-L214`](https://github.com/Birdabo404/Cribble/blob/f932e161748b1d537db2b0065d560326713fe314/src/app/(app)/bag/page.tsx#L213-L214) - [`src/components/bag/PlateSpecSheet.tsx#L77-L78`](https://github.com/Birdabo404/Cribble/blob/f932e161748b1d537db2b0065d560326713fe314/src/components/bag/PlateSpecSheet.tsx#L77-L78)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit f932e161748b1d537db2b0065d560326713fe314. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

### Keyboard equip races in-flight PATCH **Medium Severity** `activatePlate` always calls `equip` on Enter/Space, and `equip` does not ignore an in-flight request. After the optimistic flip, a second Enter treats the row as equipped and PATCHes `null`, so two writes race and the client rollback can restore the wrong plate.
Additional Locations (1) - [`src/components/bag/useBagData.ts#L219-L227`](https://github.com/Birdabo404/Cribble/blob/f932e161748b1d537db2b0065d560326713fe314/src/components/bag/useBagData.ts#L219-L227)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit f932e161748b1d537db2b0065d560326713fe314. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

Fixed in a425a74f932dd9c903452eb391435f0debd3b966: `loading` is now derived from any in-flight sync (`cosmetics === null || syncState === 'loading'`), so a RETRY keeps the register, strip and spec sheet on the SYNCING treatment instead of painting the stale neutral payload as LOCKED / GET IT. Verified with typecheck, scoped lint on the file, and the bag model tests.

Fixed in 996e4b21f971e050a5ae5fe62dedef05db70101e: `equip` in `useBagData.ts` now early-returns while a request is in flight, tracked in an `equipInFlight` ref that is set before the optimistic flip and cleared in `finally`. The ref makes the guard synchronous (not subject to a stale `equipping` closure) and it lives in the hook, so it covers every caller — keyboard `activatePlate`, the spec-sheet button and the strip button. `equipping` state is unchanged and still drives the disabled buttons. Verified with `tsc --noEmit`, `next lint` on the file, and the bag tests.

🔒 **Agentic Security Review** Severity: HIGH `linkDodoCustomer` is first-write-wins and never checks whether this Dodo `customer_id` is already stored on another Cribble user. First-time checkout also omits a bound customer and `always_create_new_customer`, so Dodo can attach the hosted session to an existing customer for the email typed on the payment page. The webhook or checkout-return ack then stores that id on the attacker’s row. `/api/portal` later treats `users.dodo_customer_id` as the only authorization key for Dodo’s hosted portal. **Impact:** A signed-in attacker who completes a checkout using a victim’s billing email can open that victim’s billing portal: invoices, payment methods, and cancel/change of the victim’s subscription. Entitlements still follow `metadata.userId`, so this is cross-account billing control and payment PII, not a free Pro grant.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Security Reviewer](https://cursor.com/docs/security-review) for commit c1f73abc1bfeee3ea50d60022671007a394f706c. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/security-agents/c5e9f158-aa11-11f1-b532-320a589b8025).
